verdict.rationale: Retention and deletion of customer and investigation data is a fair governance question for an identity, fraud and compliance platform like Alloy, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents configurable retention periods, deletion requests or a way to verify purge behavior. Docs-3 only says Alloy stores event data, docs-24 covers entity merging, and docs-8 describes webhook retry windows; none of these is a retention or deletion control.
